scope: Independent full-case content QA of F-DM-P02 as an atomic training pair

gates.blind: A/B, runners B/C, high confidence; captured before opening the key.
gates.family: Only cancellation fee changes: 9 to 60. Income, cost, 40% success, 2 test fee, timing and quality invariant; reservation separate from learning.
gates.economics: A=38−0.6f, B=26, C=4, D=0. At 9: A32.6>B26>C4>D0. At 60: B26>C4>A2>D0. Partial grades and explanations agree; A and B tie only at f=20. TC130 explicitly notes equivalence of canceling and building after failure.
gates.sourceLevel: §13.2 gives the cheap informative test before development; case supplies measured economics. Middle must compare conditional expenditures and loss from waiting, within one sponsor decision. Projection classification and eligibility match.
gates.duplicationSurface: Intentional controlled pair: same neutral title, four identical choices, different keys. TC033/034 changes the learning pilot itself; here both tested plans obtain identical evidence. TC211 uses imperfect signal.

issues.evidence: Wording compares gain in the success state (30) against expected cancellation cost. At f=30, 30>18 yet A=20 loses to B=26.
issues.fix: At fixed other inputs, compare expected upside 0.4×30=12 to expected cancellation 0.6f; A wins for f<20.

issues.evidence: The possible cancellation price must itself be probability-weighted. At f=15 the nominal fee exceeds the expected delay loss 12, yet A=29 beats B=26.
issues.fix: With other inputs fixed B wins when 0.6f>12, i.e. f>20.

issues.evidence: An unprofitable test alone does not rule out profitable direct development. E.g. success 40%, early revenue 155, late 60, fee 60: A=0, B=−2, C=2, D=0.
issues.fix: Require all three investment plans to be negative, or give a concrete verified example such as success probability 1% with original remaining terms.

retest: Focused delta of A/B/D WHEN on both siblings, preserved other fields, strict loader.
